items.title: Trishna honoured at the Clef Music Awards 2023
items.summary: At the third edition of the Clef Music Awards, Nihira's EP Trishna won in two categories: Best Artist (Hindustani Classical) and Album of the Year.

items.title: Music Unplugged features the Trishna EP
items.summary: Music Unplugged reported on Trishna, Nihira's first EP, released in December 2022: four songs about Radha's longing and love for Krishna, composed and sung by Nihira.

items.title: Rolling Stone India picks Trishna
items.summary: Rolling Stone India included the Trishna EP in its round-up of new releases to tune in to.

items.title: Ishq Manayein Kya? returns as a swing version
items.summary: Three years after the salsa original, Nihira re-recorded Ishq Manayein Kya? with new rock-and-roll and swing arrangements by Tanmay Pawar, keeping Manoj Yadav's lyrics.

items.title: Tumi: Nihira's first Bengali single
items.summary: In an interview with Planet Bollywood, Nihira talks about composing Tumi, her first song in Bengali, written by Santanu Ghatak and produced by Ashwin Srinivasan.

items.title: Monsoon single Toote Chhaate released
items.summary: Music Unplugged reported on Toote Chhaate, a rain-and-romance song composed and sung by Nihira, written by Alok Ranjan Srivastava and arranged by Rhythm Shaw, with an illustrated video by Barun Roy.

items.title: A Hindi song with Cuban salsa
items.summary: Asian Lite featured Ishq Manayein Kya?, Nihira's Hindi salsa recorded with the Cuban band Orquesta Son Diamantes and produced in Barcelona.
